archiveContract.canonicalMetadata: uid=0, gid=0, empty owner names, mtime=0, bounded modes, UTF-8 NFC paths

closedDuringReview: legacy v1 saved heads and claimed bases now use local terminal/start journal sequence instead of remote checkpoint timestamps
R2 restore now checks actual object bytes and the aggregate files plus Pi Session limit
archive restore serializes same-token attempts, retains input for replay, rejects directory races and checks USTAR name encodability
the Workspace mount cannot be renamed across the container mount boundary, so restore now verifies a staged tree inside the mount and installs it before Pi starts
Sandbox processes now use a fresh bounded attempt id while the archive token and marker retain operation idempotency
the Trusted Pi Dockerfile moved to repository root so Wrangler uses the required repository build context
the source inventory now includes the root Trusted Pi Dockerfile
